why: RM5 (night-market-remaster): the kit's ruled trim. A kit face's TEXCOORD_0 is its box-projected metres (u along the face, v up a wall or down a roof's slope) plus `band` m x its trim's number, so the kit material (data/kit.graph.json, written by scripts/open-plots/ruled-graphs.py) draws that trim's pattern over the face's palette colour; 0 or no UV is plain. Kit models map each palette slot to a trim (sp-o1, RM4). Sizes are the pattern's metres. `flagstone` needs no UV: every up-facing kit face below `under` m (the ground's paving: lanes, plaza, forecourt and court floors; lawns stand higher) is ruled in world metres, and the ring floor's own paving graph uses the same sizes.
